children: Unit Corporation (OTCQX: UNTC) (Company) announced today that a quarterly cash dividend of $1.25 per share of common stock for the third quarter of 2026 will be paid on September 25, 2026, to shareholders of record as of the close of business on September 15, 2026. The quarterly cash dividend will be funded by cash on the Company’s balance sheet.

Unit Corporation is a Tulsa-based, publicly held energy company engaged in oil and natural gas production through its wholly owned subsidiary, Unit Petroleum Company. For more information about Unit Corporation, visit its website at
